name: Salt Mirror
description: A mineral growth that learned to imitate the figures reflected in its faces. It hovers on a narrow point above the salt floor.

abilities.description: Reflects 3 magical damage once when the combined direct attack damages it. Ward can absorb this.
Reduces incoming magical damage by 15 percent using the shared resistance rules.
